The picture becomes clear: fraudsters have exploited a vulnerability in your checkout system, launching a coordinated attack using compromised payment methods at scale. Your response is immediate but blunt - block suspicious transactions. Unfortunately, legitimate customers get caught in the crossfire, their valid purchases declined along with the fraudulent ones.
